items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Can you remember anything about your lessons with Professor Renetta?

ctx.x: Well, um... You say he's dead.

He's dead. Died in 1949. Oh, I see. He's one of the most famous clarinets. Professor Renetta talks a lot about him. He was a close friend of his. He worked a lot with him too. So he retired when he was about 50 or so he said from music then.
